# World of Cars — llms.txt
# Canonical: https://worldofcarsmakemoney.dev/
# Updated: 2026-09-14. Languages: en, es, zh, hi, fr, ar, pt, ru (?lang=).

> World of Cars is a free online arcade car racing game. Customize your car,
> race 5 unique tracks, join online lobbies with virtual coins. No download,
> no real money. 8 languages.

## Play
- https://worldofcarsmakemoney.dev/ — Play free in the browser.

## What it is
- Genre: arcade racing. Modes: offline Grand Prix (2 laps) and online lobbies.
- Garage: car body, paint, decals, eyes, hats, wheels, spoilers, neon underglow, boost FX.
- Tracks (5): Ornament Valley GP, Sunset Beach Drift, Motor Speedway of the South, Sakura Mountain Run, Riviera Rosso Circuit.
- Difficulty: EASY / MEDIUM / HARD. Stats: top speed, handling, boost.

## Controls
- WASD or arrow keys: drive. SPACE: turbo boost. H: horn. R: headlights.
- Touch controls appear automatically on mobile.

## Online lobbies (virtual coins)
- Create or join with a 4-letter code. Minimum bet: 1 virtual coin.
- Winner takes 90% of the pot. Quitters forfeit their bet. No real money involved.

## Languages
- English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian.
- Switch with the globe button in the header or via ?lang= (e.g. /?lang=es).

## FAQ
- Is it free? Yes — browser only, virtual coins, no real money, no download.
- How do I start? Press PLAY OFFLINE, customize, pick a track, press START RACE.
- Online? 4-letter lobby codes; winner takes 90% of the virtual pot.
- Mobile? Yes, automatic touch controls.
- Progress? Saved in the browser (offline); lobby balances server-side (online).

## About / FAQ page section
- https://worldofcarsmakemoney.dev/#aboutmodal — in-game About dialog with FAQ.
